It's like a hidden gem I discovered while traveling in Korea.
It's a pity that it doesn't seem to be well known, perhaps because it's located inside a building.

My wife and I had three cups of drip coffee and one cup of espresso, and every cup was perfectly roasted, brewed, and cleanly constructed. The barista's understanding and skills were also excellent.

I've only tried drip coffee and not iced coffee, but the quality is on par with other famous specialty coffee shops in Melbourne.

Highly recommended to anyone who wants to experience authentic black coffee.
In particular, espresso served in a champagne glass provided a much richer sensory experience than a typical cupping glass.

It was a blend of Ethiopian washed and natural coffee beans, and the extraction was so clean and well-balanced that no carbonated water was added at all.

The subtle floral scent reminiscent of white acacia flowers was truly impressive.

The espresso deserves a 10 out of 10. 👍
Plus, the luxurious packaging that would fit on the shelves of a high-end retail store adds to its specialness.

reviews.author: This is May
reviews.text:
This is a review written after receiving the service through an experience group.

It was close to Exit 11 of Gangnam Station, so it was easily accessible. As soon as I entered the store, I was impressed by the Yonggung concept interior, and the lighting and overall atmosphere were calm, making it easy to eat without being noisy. We visited as a group of two women and chose course A for lunch, which was well-organized and the portion size was reasonable. The cheese tomato cold salad was good to whet the appetite, and the obang tteokbokki was sweet and went well with alcohol. For the meal, we shared beef pork belly Cheongyang sujebi and fried kimchi fried rice, both of which were satisfactory. I was informed that only courses were available for lunch and single items could be ordered for dinner, and the staff kindly explained things to me, which was nice. There is also a room, so I would recommend it as a blind date or a quiet meeting place.

reviews.author: river sea
reviews.text:
This article was written after receiving meals and drinks from the company through the experience group.

Today I went to Jushindang Gangnam in Gangnam. It is a Korean casual dining pub with the concept of Yonggung, so the atmosphere is unique from the entrance, and the space itself is very sensuous, making it a perfect place for a date or gathering. It was a place where you naturally became intoxicated with the atmosphere thanks to the lighting and interior.

We ordered red sesame tartare, cat cake, cow cocktail, horse cocktail, and Seoseol traditional liquor. The red sesame tartare was impressive for its clean yet deep flavor, and the plating was pretty, so I was satisfied from the start. The cat cake looked so cute that I couldn't help but take a picture of it, and it was the perfect ending to dessert.

Each cocktail had its own distinct personality, making it fun to drink, and Seoseol traditional liquor went well with the entire menu, adding to the atmosphere. Overall, it is a place where food, drinks, and space all come together well, so I would recommend this place to those looking for a Gangnam bar with a good atmosphere.

reviews.text:
It's a 3-minute cut from Exit 11 of Gangnam Station, and the entrance stairs are covered with blue lights, making it feel like you're entering another world. From the huge dragon decoration at the entrance to the 70-pyeong open interior, the atmosphere is unrivaled in Gangnam. 🐲✨

🍸 Menu recommendation & taste review

Tiger Cocktail: The sight of dried persimmons in a pipe glass is amazing! The combination of the spicy ginger scent and the heavy whiskey is truly luxurious.

Pig Cocktail: Just a premium version of Pig Bar! The fluffy strawberry cream and toasted marshmallows make it a nice, sweet treat to enjoy.

Injeolmi Tiramisu: The fragrant soybean powder and creamy cheese melt in your mouth. If you come here, be sure to order this!

💡 Tips for use

The spacing between the tables is wide and the lighting is soft, so there is no better place for a blind date at Gangnam Station.

There is no room charge for the group room, so it would be the best for a company dinner or gathering!

If you are looking for a unique bar in Gangnam with a clear concept, you should definitely go to Juindang.

I came to Gangnam Station for a date with my boyfriend and left with dozens of photos of our lives. I recommend a bar in Gangnam Station to those who are tired of typical bars! 200% intention to visit again. 💖

reviews.author: Hajin
reviews.text: I was excited because it felt like I was entering a dragon palace from the entrance, and the soft lighting illuminated my face beautifully, so I thought it would be a perfect place for a blind date. The five-flowered pork we ordered was really soft thanks to the sous vide cooking, and the five-spice sauce wasn't overpowering, so it had an impressive, luxurious taste. The honey butter potato pancake is a perfect combination of crispy and chewy with the addition of yolk! The makgeolli cocktail was sweet and smooth, so even if you don't drink much, it wasn't a burden, and the tteokbokki was so addictive that I kept reaching for it. Group seating is available, so it looks like a good place for a company dinner. I was also satisfied with the fact that the bathrooms were separate for men and women, so it was clean! I recommend it if you want a sentimental drinking experience in Gangnam.
